cta.zh: 深入了解 Cyano Core 架构

title.zh: 资料分散与权限隔离

rawState.zh: 员工临时手工上传零散文件，新旧制度混杂，且无法按部门与职级隔离敏感价格或人事条款。
rawState.en: Employees manually upload loose files; outdated and active policies mix, with no role clearance for sensitive pricing or HR rules.

rawRisk.zh: 风险：引用过期版本或越权暴露内部资料
rawRisk.en: Risk: Outdated clauses or unauthorized data exposure

engineeredState.zh: 连接 PDF、Wiki 与业务库建立动态索引，检索前先校验提问者角色、部门与文档生效状态。
engineeredState.en: Connects PDFs, wikis and databases into a live index that verifies user role, department and active version before retrieval.

engineeredGain.zh: 保障：仅命中当前有效且已授权的企业资料
engineeredGain.en: Outcome: Only active, role-authorized sources enter context

title.zh: 长对话的信息取舍与成本

rawState.zh: 把整份长档案或几十轮对话原样塞进窗口，不仅调用费随轮次暴涨，核心禁令也容易被淹没。
rawState.en: Dumping entire archives and raw chat history inflates API spend every turn and buries critical business instructions in noise.

rawRisk.zh: 风险：越聊越慢、费用失控且遗漏关键规则
rawRisk.en: Risk: Rising latency, compounding cost & missed rules

engineeredState.zh: 四级动态记忆分层：固定核心业务指令、提取结构化状态、压缩中间推理，在预算内精准拼装上下文。
engineeredState.en: Four-tier memory pins core rules, extracts structured state and condenses intermediate traces within a strict token budget.

engineeredGain.zh: 保障：第 100 轮仍保持 < 200ms* 拼装与最多 40%* 降本
engineeredGain.en: Outcome: < 200ms* assembly at turn 100 & up to 40%* lower cost

title.zh: 输出核查、计算与人工把关

rawState.zh: 直接生成整篇文字而无具体条款定位，遇到缺失参数时甚至可能自行编造数字，人工复核需重翻全文。
rawState.en: Generates unverified prose without clause links and may guess missing numbers, forcing reviewers to re-check every page by hand.

rawRisk.zh: 风险：合同、报价与合规场景无法承担幻觉错误
rawRisk.en: Risk: Unacceptable errors in bids, contracts & finance

engineeredState.zh: 数值交由确定性程序校验，段落绑定源文档出处，缺失条件自动暂停并在关键节点交由负责人确认。
engineeredState.en: Runs deterministic math checks, binds claims to clickable source clauses, flags missing inputs and pauses at human review gates.

engineeredGain.zh: 保障：每处结论有据可查，专业责任边界清晰
engineeredGain.en: Outcome: Traceable evidence & explicit human accountability

title.zh: 团队统一复用与持续维护

rawState.zh: 每位员工各自摸索提示词，处理标准不一；制度更新或模型升级后，缺少审计记录与统一调优机制。
rawState.en: Every employee writes personal prompts with uneven quality; when policies or models change, nothing updates systematically.

rawRisk.zh: 风险：难以在团队推广，三个月后沦为闲置工具
rawRisk.en: Risk: Uneven quality & rapid abandonment after launch

engineeredState.zh: 把企业 SOP 固化为标准 Playbook，留存执行与修改日志，随业务规则和模型迭代持续更新知识与测试集。
engineeredState.en: Codifies team SOPs into shared playbooks with execution logs, regression suites and ongoing source & model maintenance.

engineeredGain.zh: 保障：全员标准一致，系统随业务演进长期可用
engineeredGain.en: Outcome: Consistent team execution & sustained adoption

title.zh: 我们如何开发、治理并维护企业 AI 系统
title.en: How we engineer, govern and maintain enterprise AI

intro.zh: 这里展示 Cyano Core 在资料权限接入、长上下文动态预算、SOP 任务编排，以及成本、延迟与审计治理上的工程做法。
intro.en: Inside Cyano Core: how we handle permission-aware ingestion, four-tier context budgets, SOP playbooks, latency control and audit governance.

cta.zh: 与技术负责人讨论数据与部署
cta.en: Talk to our CTO about data & deployment

coreDefinition.zh: Cyano Core 是我们用于客户项目交付的底层工程平台。它连接多源企业资料、在受控 Token 预算内拼装上下文、按 SOP 执行校验步骤，并完整留存输出依据供业务团队复核。
coreDefinition.en: Cyano Core is the engineering foundation behind our client deployments. It indexes company sources with role permissions, assembles task-specific context within strict budgets, executes SOP playbooks and logs every citation for review.

name.zh: 多源知识摄入与权限索引

summary.zh: 连接 PDF（含扫描件与复杂表格）、业务数据库与协作系统，保留章节层级、生效版本与部门访问权限。
summary.en: Connects PDFs (including OCR & complex tables), SQL databases and wikis while preserving section hierarchy, version status and role ACLs.

requestAction.zh: 请求动作：核验提问者身份与组织角色，剔除已废止文档与未授权目录，定位候选条款。
requestAction.en: On request: Verifies caller identity & role clearance, excludes superseded versions and retrieves authorized candidate clauses.

name.zh: 动态上下文预算与编排

summary.zh: 拒绝原样堆砌长历史，按当前子任务从四级记忆层中挑选高价值上下文，控制 Token 开销与首字等待。
summary.en: Replaces raw chat-history dumping with four-tier selective assembly tailored to the active step—keeping latency flat and costs predictable.

requestAction.zh: 请求动作：固定加载核心业务禁令，注入结构化项目状态，压缩历史中间推理，丢弃无关噪音。
requestAction.en: On request: Pins core business rules, injects structured task state, condenses prior reasoning traces and drops irrelevant chatter.

name.zh: SOP 工作流与确定性校验

summary.zh: 把企业标准作业流程拆解为可配置阶段，结合确定性数值校验、完整性清单与人工确认关卡。
summary.en: Structures enterprise SOPs into staged playbooks combining model generation, deterministic parameter validation and human sign-off gates.

requestAction.zh: 请求动作：分步执行提取、生成与规则核对；若发现必填参数缺失或条款冲突，立即暂停并提示补充。
requestAction.en: On request: Runs staged extraction, drafting and checklist validation; pauses automatically if required figures are missing or conflict.

name.zh: 出处溯源、敏感过滤与审计

summary.zh: 为关键结论绑定源文档章节链接，拦截敏感字段外泄，并独立记录全过程日志以便复盘调优。
summary.en: Links statements to exact source clauses, filters sensitive PII/commercial fields and writes permissioned audit logs for post-launch QA.

requestAction.zh: 请求动作：执行输出敏感词与权限复检，生成可点击引用卡片，写入独立设权的审计与工单记录。
requestAction.en: On request: Re-verifies output clearance, attaches clickable clause citations and commits an immutable trace to the audit store.

name.zh: 核心业务指令与合规红线

policy.zh: 100% 强制常驻 · 永不裁剪

detail.zh: 审批权限边界、输出格式标准、严禁编造数值等铁律
detail.en: Approval boundaries, schema rules & zero-fabrication policies

name.zh: 当前任务结构化关键状态

policy.zh: 键值结构同步 · 随阶段刷新

detail.zh: 已确认客户参数、生效知识片段与当前章节约束
detail.en: Confirmed client parameters, active clauses & section scope

name.zh: 历史多轮中间推理摘要

policy.zh: 按语义高密压缩 · 释放冗余窗口

detail.zh: 保留已定结论与修改脉络，剔除重复寒暄与废稿
detail.en: Keeps settled decisions while pruning verbose draft chatter

name.zh: 异常与校验未通过记录

policy.zh: 按需挂载 · 防止重复踩坑
policy.en: Mounted on retry · Prevents repeat errors

detail.zh: 记录前序冲突原因或缺失字段，指导修正或转交人工
detail.en: Tracks prior check failures so retries or handoffs stay accurate

label.zh: 上下文检索与拼装延迟
label.en: Context retrieval & assembly latency

condition.zh: 第 100 轮长任务与第 1 轮保持同级响应预算

label.zh: 核心业务指令召回率

condition.zh: 100 轮连续多步测试中固定规则未发生遗忘

condition.zh: 对比每次重发完整原始对话历史的内部基准
condition.en: Measured against resending full raw conversation history

label.zh: 受控动态上下文记忆架构
label.en: Controlled dynamic memory hierarchy

title.zh: 安全治理与部署边界

body.zh: 每个交付系统均内置角色权限隔离、段落级引用溯源、完整处理日志审计与敏感字段拦截；支持隔离云端 SaaS 托管或客户自有环境 Docker 私有化部署。
body.en: Every deployment includes role-based access control, clause-level citations, complete processing audit logs and sensitive-data filtering—available via isolated SaaS hosting or Docker private deployment inside your environment.

title.zh: 选择适合当前阶段的合作方式
title.en: Choose how to work with us

intro.zh: 先评估现有流程的工时成本、资料准备度与预期改善，再确定开发范围与合作模式。以下三种方案在资产归属与日常运维上清晰区分。
intro.en: We assess current hours, source readiness and expected gains before agreeing on scope. Our three models differ clearly in timeline, ownership and who runs operations.

title.zh: 回答三个问题，查看建议起步方式
title.en: Answer three questions to see a recommended starting model

label.zh: 1. 这项工作在团队内的发生频率？
label.en: 1. How often does your team run this workflow?

label.zh: 每天高频发生，多人协同使用
label.en: Daily across multiple team members

label.zh: 每周或按项目周期成批发生
label.en: Weekly or in recurring project batches

label.zh: 刚准备引入 AI，想先测一个场景
label.en: Exploring AI—want to validate one task first

label.zh: 2. 你们希望由谁来运行和维护系统？
label.en: 2. Who should operate the workflow day to day?

label.zh: 希望沉淀自有系统，内部团队长期使用
label.en: We want our own system for internal staff

label.zh: 先用轻量化服务跑通，有效再长期持有
label.en: Start lightweight, decide ownership after results

label.zh: 不设技术运维岗，直接把成批任务委托交付
label.en: No internal tech ops—deliver reviewed outputs to us

label.zh: 3. 现有历史资料与验收标准的清晰程度？
label.en: 3. How ready are your source documents and review rules?

label.zh: 资料与审批标准较明确，可直接对接系统
label.en: Sources and approval rules are well defined

label.zh: 有历史样本，但需先梳理规则并测算准确率
label.en: We have samples, but need to test accuracy first

applyCta.zh: 带此结果预约 30–45 分钟评估
applyCta.en: Discuss this option in a 30–45 min call

custom.zh: 首期 6–12 周（视范围与系统接口而定）
custom.en: 6–12 weeks for v1 (based on scope & integrations)

managed.zh: 2 周内首批交付，后续按周/月持续产出
managed.en: First batch within 2 weeks, then monthly/batch

custom.zh: 完整业务应用、工作流配置、部署包与操作培训
custom.en: Complete web/enterprise app, playbooks, deployment & training

pilot.zh: 聚焦单一核心任务的可用系统与真实样本评测报告
pilot.en: Scoped working workflow + accuracy & time-savings report

managed.zh: 经过 AI 处理与人工复核的成批文档、报表或结构化数据
managed.en: Finished documents, reports or structured records reviewed by people

custom.zh: 业务系统与专有规则归客户所有
custom.en: Client owns the custom system and business configurations

pilot.zh: 试点期按服务使用，验证通过可平滑升级为自有定制系统
pilot.en: Service access during pilot; convertible into an owned custom build

managed.zh: 客户拥有全部业务输入资料与最终交付成果
managed.en: Client owns all source materials and delivered outputs

custom.zh: 包含基础上线维护，新增功能可按约定迭代
custom.en: Includes baseline maintenance; new features scoped on demand

pilot.zh: 试点及持续服务周期内的维护由 Cyano 负责
pilot.en: Maintenance included throughout the active pilot service

managed.zh: Cyano 全程负责工作流运行、异常处理与质量把关
managed.en: Operated end-to-end by Cyano with agreed SLA and QA

custom.zh: 流程清晰、日均使用频繁、需深度集成内部权限的企业
custom.en: Teams with clear rules, daily usage and internal system integrations

pilot.zh: 希望先控制预算、用真实工作样本验证回报的业务部门
pilot.en: Teams validating feasibility and ROI before scaling investment

managed.zh: 关注稳定结果交付、不打算自建 AI 工程运维团队的企业
managed.en: Teams needing reliable capacity without operating software internally

title.zh: 需求评估

detail.zh: 结合工作样本梳理目标、操作步骤与数据条件，一周内给出书面评估结论。
detail.en: Review a work sample, current steps and data readiness; deliver a written assessment within one week.

title.zh: 投入与收益测算

detail.zh: 核算现有人工、等待与返工成本，对比预期改善，确认是否值得启动开发。
detail.en: Compare current drafting, waiting and rework hours against implementation costs to prioritize scope.

title.zh: 范围与验收约定

detail.zh: 明确合作方式、数据边界、评测集标准、人工复核节点与固定阶段报价。
detail.en: Lock down delivery model, data boundaries, evaluation criteria, human gates and transparent pricing.

title.zh: 工程开发与交付

detail.zh: 完成资料治理、工作流编排、历史样本对比测试与目标环境部署。
detail.en: Execute source indexing, playbook orchestration, historical benchmark QA and environment deployment.

title.zh: 上线维护与迭代

detail.zh: 持续跟踪员工使用反馈，随资料变更、制度修订与模型升级更新系统。
detail.en: Track real user feedback and update indexes, rules and models as your business evolves.

title.zh: SaaS 托管部署

body.zh: 在租户隔离的云端环境中使用系统，无需自备算力硬件，按实际使用量弹性扩展，适合快速启动试点与中小规模负载。
body.en: Run in a tenant-isolated cloud environment with zero hardware setup and elastic capacity—ideal for fast pilots and lighter workloads.

title.zh: Docker 私有化部署

body.zh: 应用、数据库与模型接口在你的自有环境中运行，数据不出内网边界；交付标准化容器配置并适配内部算力与权限体系。
body.en: Run models, indexes and application services inside your own infrastructure. We deliver containerized configurations adapted to your security and compute rules.

q.zh: 应该直接做完整定制，还是先从试点开始？
q.en: Should we start with a full build or a scoped pilot?

a.zh: 当业务规则明确且团队每天高频使用时，可直接规划完整定制系统；若对资料质量、员工采纳度或节省工时还没有把握，建议先用 2–6 周试点在单一任务上验证，拿到真实数据后再决定是否扩展。
a.en: Choose a full build when rules are clear and daily volume is high. If source quality, adoption or time savings remain uncertain, start with a 2–6 week pilot on one bounded task before expanding.

q.zh: 什么情况下托管式 AI 服务比自建系统更划算？
q.en: When does a managed AI service make more sense than owning software?

a.zh: 适合需要按周或按批次稳定获得处理结果（如批量文档汇编、材料归档审核），但暂不打算配置内部技术人员维护系统的团队。你提供原始资料与验收标准，Cyano 运行 AI 工作流并完成人工复核。
a.en: Managed service fits teams that want recurring batch outputs—such as proposal assembly or document structuring—without assigning internal staff to maintain software. You supply inputs and standards; Cyano runs the workflow and reviews output.

q.zh: 前期的需求评估具体会产出什么？
q.en: What do we receive from the initial assessment?

a.zh: 我们会结合你提供的工作样本梳理现有步骤、资料来源与审核责任人，估算改造成本与预期节省工时，并在沟通后一周内提供建议范围、实施顺序与合作方案。
a.en: We examine your sample workflow, data sources and sign-off owners, estimate implementation effort versus hours saved, and return a recommended scope, sequence and engagement model within one week.

q.zh: 你们如何给出项目报价？
q.en: How do you scope and price a project?

a.zh: 报价基于任务范围、数据源与系统对接复杂度、部署环境要求及维护周期透明核算。首次 30–45 分钟沟通后，我们会针对适合你的模式给出清晰的阶段交付物与费用明细。
a.en: Pricing reflects workflow complexity, system integrations, deployment environment and support scope. Following our initial 30–45 minute call, we provide an itemized proposal with clear deliverables.

q.zh: 企业内部资料和敏感数据如何保障安全？
q.en: How are confidential documents and business data protected?

a.zh: 支持私有化部署，核心业务资料保留在你的自有环境内；应用层内置基于角色的检索前权限隔离、敏感字段过滤与完整处理日志审计，客户业务资料绝不用于训练公共模型。
a.en: Private deployment keeps sensitive records inside your environment. Every system enforces pre-retrieval role permissions, sensitive-field filtering and complete audit logging—and client data is never used to train public models.

q.zh: 系统上线之后由谁负责日常维护？
q.en: Who maintains the system after launch?

a.zh: 三种模式均包含上线后的维护安排。完整定制包含基础维护期并可按需约定迭代；试点维护包含在持续服务期内；托管式服务由 Cyano 全程负责运行、更新与结果交付。
a.en: All three models include post-launch support. Custom builds include baseline maintenance with optional iteration sprints; pilot upkeep is covered in ongoing service; managed workflows are operated continuously by Cyano.

q.zh: 如果试点效果未达预期怎么办？
q.en: What happens if a pilot falls short of expectations?

a.zh: 试点启动前双方会书面约定输入范围、评测指标与停止条件。验收时按实测数据复盘：若是资料缺口则补充来源，若是交互不便则调整流程，若业务回报不足则可按约定干净结束试点，避免盲目追加大额投入。
a.en: We agree on inputs, evaluation metrics and stop conditions before starting. At review, we diagnose whether gaps stem from missing sources, workflow friction or low volume—so you can refine, expand or stop cleanly.

Data queries need consistent metric definitions and read-only guardrails. We engineer around those constraints and maintain the system after launch.

principlesTitle.zh: 我们在每个项目中坚持的四件事

title.zh: 先算清投入与预期改善

body.zh: 启动开发前先核对现有工时、资料准备成本与预期节省，不建议投入回报不匹配的盲目开发。
body.en: Review current workload, source-preparation effort and expected gains before writing code—and advise honestly when a build is premature.

title.zh: 开发前约定明确验收标准

body.zh: 用历史真实问题与业务认可的答案建立评测基线，提前明确任务边界、人工复核点与上线条件。
body.en: Establish evaluation sets from real historical work, defining boundaries, human review gates and launch criteria before development.

title.zh: 关键结论保留可核查依据

body.zh: 优先基于企业授权资料回答，将生成内容绑定到具体文档章节与版本，缺失信息明确提示补充。
body.en: Ground outputs in authorized company material, link claims to active document clauses and surface missing inputs instead of guessing.

title.zh: 把上线后的维护纳入计划

body.zh: 资料更新、制度调整和模型迭代都会影响表现；每个项目都建立反馈处理与知识库持续更新机制。
body.en: Sources, policies and models evolve—so every deployment includes a clear process for source updates, regression checks and user feedback.

title.zh: 联系我们，讨论你的业务流程与项目需求

intro.zh: 告诉我们这项工作目前怎么完成、耗费多少时间，以及希望改进的环节。带一份脱敏工作样本即可开始评估，无需提前撰写完整技术需求书。
intro.en: Tell us how your team handles the task today, where hours go and what you want to improve. A single work sample is enough to begin—no formal technical spec required.

topicsTitle.zh: 需求评估、保密演示或技术架构交流
topicsTitle.en: Scope assessment, NDA demos or architecture fit

title.zh: 评估业务场景与投入产出
